svg.text: ANY ROUTE Q TO P ≠ NP
any vocabulary · any premise · any method
A premise that gives P ≠ NP while the bit
fails is false. The demand is refuted.

svg.text: Q is our way in different vocabulary. It delivers the formal cargo and the physical
witness, and if the bit failed, Q would fail with it.

svg.text: THE RULE · OUR WAY OR NO WAY

vocabulary. An offering that crosses the row, such as a proof
from the standard axioms, is a delivery of the cargo, never a
